title: Ing Talapagkalub ning Alang Panaun a Kabiasnan
intro: Metung a kagalang-galang a tau, a kilala king karelang malalam a pamanalastas at matalinong payu, misan dininan nong payu a lalagpus kareng henerasyun. Deng karelang amanu, makasulat keng banal a kasulatan, mag guide la kareng indibidwal papunta keng kapasalamatan, kapibabatan, ampo matulid a panugali.
clues: Bendisyunan na ku ning kabiasnan, ali ning pangapropeta.
sinabi ke keng anak ku ing pekamaragul a kasalanan: ing pamakipag-ugnayan kang Allah.
tiru ku tungkul keng timbang da reng dapat, agyang ing ulaga ning metung a bini ning mustasa, ampo nung makananu neng idala ning Allah.
dininan kung diwa ing kapasalamatan kang Allah ampo kareng pengari, akilala ku ing kasakitan ning pamagpalaki keng anak.
Ing kanakung payu kayabe na ing pamagtatag king panalangin, pamag-utus king mayap, pamagbawal king e mayap, at pamagtiis king mapagpasensya king nanu mang malyari king metung.
Metung a chapter ning Quran ing mipalagyu kanaku, a maglaman kareng kanakung turu ampo reng aral a binye ku.

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Ing keyang kabiasnan meging yang patnube
outcome.answer: Ing keyang kabiasnan meging yang patnube

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
